typesense:explore.greeting:
Justin: “Hey. Colton?”
Colton: “Yeah. Hey, man.”
Justin: “Well, damn. You actually called.”
Colton: laughs “You told me to.”
Justin: “I did. Wasn’t sure you were gonna do it, though.”
Colton: “Why wouldn’t I?”
Justin: “I don’t know. You seem a little shy.”
Colton: “I’m not shy.”
Justin: laughs “Okay. We’ll go with that.”

That last exchange feels particularly right for them because Justin has already discovered the button he likes pushing. Colton doesn't think of himself as shy—he probably isn't in ordinary life—but Justin can tell he's nervous with him.

Then I could imagine five or ten minutes of surprisingly normal conversation: where they're from, work, football, what they're doing that night, maybe joking about something from their messages. Justin doesn't need to immediately sexualize everything. In fact, he'd probably enjoy letting Colton get comfortable and then occasionally dropping in something that makes him stumble.

Eventually Justin might say something like:

Justin: “You know, you're a lot more talkative on the phone than I expected.”
Colton: “What'd you expect?”
Justin: “I figured I'd have to drag everything out of you.”
Colton: “You haven't exactly been having trouble.”
Justin: “Not yet.”
pause
Justin: “You still thinking about coming over?”
Colton: “Maybe.”
Justin: “There it is again.”
Colton: “What?”
Justin: “That ‘maybe’ shit. You know damn well you've been thinking about it.”
typesense:explore.name: Colton
typesense:explore.title: masc muscl cub for dom bro
